title: Seoul to withdraw half of embassy staff from Ukraine as POW disclosure dispute deepens
caption:
South Korea is withdrawing roughly half of its diplomatic personnel from Kyiv following an escalating dispute over North Korean prisoners of war. Seoul claims Ukraine breached a secret agreement by announcing the transfer at the UN General Assembly.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul to withdraw half of embassy staff from Ukraine as POW disclosure dispute deepens
